MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 38
   D. 88

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 19

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

6. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 64
   D. 8

7. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 120
   D. 46

13. Solve for x: x + 7 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 17

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 25

18. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 0
   D. 16

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

20. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

22. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
